a11yButton: Talk to $t(common:appName). Voice chat about this report.
title: $t(common:appName)
subtitle: Talk to $t(common:appName) about this report
privacy: Your voice is sent to Google to answer. Nothing is recorded or saved.
declined: You chose not to use the microphone. Tap Try again when you want to talk, or close this and read the report.

ended.cap: Time is up. Start again to ask more.

errors.mic_denied: The microphone is off. Allow it in your phone settings to talk, or close this and read the report.
errors.mic_denied_web: The microphone is blocked. Allow it for this site in your browser settings, or close this and read the report.
errors.unavailable: Live voice is not available right now. Try again later, or close this and read the report.
errors.rate_limited: You have used many checks this hour. Try again later.
errors.busy: Another voice conversation is open. Close it and try again.
errors.not_found: This report is no longer available. Run the check again.
errors.upstream: The voice service had a problem. Try again.
errors.bad_request: The voice service could not start. Try again.
errors.audio: Audio is not available on this device.

companion.name: $t(common:appName)
companion.previewClose: Tap to close. This picture is not saved.
companion.unavailable: Voice is not available right now
companion.rateLimited: You have used many checks this hour
companion.notFound: Check the screen again to talk
companion.endedCap: Time is up. Double tap the doll to talk again
companion.muteA11y: Double tap to mute the microphone
companion.unmuteA11y: Double tap to turn the microphone on
companion.permissionBody: Optional. Double tap the floating doll, or tap Ask on a result, to talk about what is on your screen. $t(common:appName) needs the microphone for this.
companion.permissionStep: Optional: allow the microphone so you can talk to $t(common:appName) from the bubble.
companion.micBlocked: The microphone is blocked. Allow it for $t(common:appName) in Android Settings.
companion.a11yCheckScreen: Double tap to check the screen.
companion.errNoConnection: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
companion.errTooMany: Too many checks. Wait a minute and try again.

companion.errTooLarge: The screenshot is too large to check.
